Validation Summary
Because tectonic reconstructions are prone to subtle errors, I have explicitly validated each transformation step.

Tectonic model checks
• Plate rotation → Plates rotate back in deep time (visually confirmed). [Day 3 Log, 31/05/2025]
• Coastline rotation → Coastlines rotate as expected; paleocoordinates differ substantially from present-day coordinates. [Day 3 Log, 31/05/2025]
• Plate ID assignment → Fossils are correctly assigned plate IDs (verified via printed outputs). [Day 10 Log, 18/07/2025]

Fossil-level checks
• Identity → At 0 Ma, reconstructed fossils exactly match original locations. [Day 10 Log, 19/07/2025]
• Rotation → Fossils show consistent displacement vectors when reconstructed at 10 Ma intervals (0–250 Ma). [Day 11 Log, 30/08/2025]
• Artifacts → Apparent “migration” of present-day fossils in deep time is confirmed to be a visual lifetime artifact (species phasing in/out), not actual movement. [Day 12 Log, 31/08/2025]
